pkgmetadata.longdescription: Garmin Express updates firmware and maps of Garmin devices and syncs activities. Upstream only ships Windows and macOS builds; this package installs the Windows installer plus the .NET Framework 4.0/4.8 and d3dcompiler_47 runtimes into /opt and sets up a per-user Wine prefix on first start. Devices that appear as a USB drive work; MTP-only watches are not visible to Wine.
